summary.result: Overall, the life cycle of CO₂ emissions was shortened.
summary.background: Accordingly, this paper analyzed the benefits of increasing the use of high-calorific coal for the life cycle of CO₂ emissions for electricity generation in a coal power plant.
summary.method: To this end, the electricity generation process is divided into four stages of fuel transportation, combustion, air pollutant treatment and by-product treatment.
